en_quote: Before escalating an investigation to confirm and report suspicion, an analyst is expected to understand the nature of the suspicion and determine whether there is a possible explanation for the transaction.
knowledge_zh: 分析师在升级调查前必须理解可疑性质并判断是否有合理解释

en_quote: Any patterns of previous transactions from the same account or customer should also be reviewed.
knowledge_zh: 应审查同一账户或客户的过往交易模式

en_quote: Information gathered during onboarding, along with historical transaction data, can provide helpful context.
knowledge_zh: 开户时收集的信息和历史交易数据可提供有用背景

en_quote: Finally, all research should be clearly documented, indicating what information—if any—is missing.
knowledge_zh: 所有研究应清晰记录，并注明缺失的信息
